llm.summary: This is a documentation-only QA modeling skill that helps structure state, data-flow, and service-dependency analysis without requesting execution, network, write, or persistence capabilities.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose and artifact content are coherent: it guides agents to build state-machine, data-flow, and service-dependency views for complex requirements and testing scope analysis.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The activation guidance includes broad terms such as general modeling and complex business-process understanding, which could cause occasional over-invocation, but the runtime instructions remain focused on domain modeling outputs.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains a single SKILL.md markdown file, with no executable scripts or hidden install behavior indicated in the artifact metadata.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Allowed tools are limited to Read, Grep, and Glob, which are proportionate for inspecting requirements or scenario-tree inputs needed for modeling.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background execution, privilege escalation, credential handling, network calls, or mutation authority is requested or described.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this if you want an agent to help analyze complex requirements into state, data-flow, and service-dependency models. Use it on relevant project or requirements material, and be mindful that broad trigger wording may make the agent apply it to some general modeling requests where a narrower skill might be enough.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger wording is a real usability and scoping note, but artifact evidence shows no code execution or data movement beyond normal read-only context gathering for modeling.
